jobs.title: Platform
jobs.description: Platform: Agentic CIRM from readiness to regulator | Cytactic Platform Company Resources Careers Book a Demo Platform The Agentic CIRM Hub Cytactic unifies people, processes, and platforms into a single operating layer, enabling organizations to execute fast, synchronized, and effective cyber incident response that reduces Mean Time to Respond (MTTR) and limits incident impact. Book a Demo Agentic Execution Agentic CIRM Execution Intent-Driven Orchestration Interprets user requests, structures required inputs, and translates intent into coordinated response actions, eliminating manual workflow translation during high-pressure incidents. Embedded Expert Agents Leverages domain-specific agents across security, legal, communications, and operations to guide execution, reduce decision friction, and ensure actions align with best practices and regulatory requirements. Governed, Cross-Surface Execution Enables users to initiate and manage response actions from the platform or collaboration tools like Slack and Claude, with all actions structured, approved, and executed through Cytactic as the system of record. Proactive Readiness Proactive Readiness Playbook Builder These playbooks go beyond generic templates, offering deep configurability and customization for various crisis types, ensuring their precise alignment with internal and external procedures and obligations. Risk-tuned, Realistic Crisis Simulation (Digital TTX) Scenario-based digital TTX tailored to your threat landscape. These immersive exercises mirror real-world pressure, test response plans, and build team readiness. Post-simulation reports turn insights into action for continuous improvement. Team Simulations, Training & Drills Technology-driven simulations that mirror real cyber crises, hands-on drills that enable teams to practice roles, workflows, and tools, building coordination, confidence, and muscle memory for real incidents. Embedded Expertise Embedded Expertise Decision Support Tools These tools analyze real-time and historical data to guide strategic, fact-based responses, aligning actions with business priorities and mitigating damage during cyber crises. Crisis Communication AI Agent A centralized hub for drafting crisis communications, empowers the generation of tailored messages for each audience: regulators, partners, media, customers and internal employees. Legal Disclosures AI Agent AI-driven workspace streamlining disclosure management, auto-drafting, deadline tracking, and ensuring global regulatory compliance. AI Expert Agent These tools analyze real-time and historical data to guide strategic, fact-based responses, aligning actions with business priorities and mitigating damage during cyber crises. Unified Incident Response Hub Unified Incident Response Hub Out-of-Band Communications Ensure secure, reliable communication across stakeholders, even when primary systems are disrupted or compromised. Cross-Functional Workflow Orchestration Drive coordinated execution across technical, legal, and business teams with full visibility into actions, ownership, and dependencies. Roles & Automated Task Assignment Enforce structured execution by assigning actions based on defined roles, ensuring accountability and eliminating delays during a live incident. Adaptive Response Adaptive Response Dynamic Response Plan Real-time evolving playbooks that adjust as the crisis unfolds, keeping response strategies relevant and proactive. Continuous Impact Assessment Ongoing evaluation of crisis impact across financial, legal, reputational, and operational areas, based on evolving intelligence. Are you ready?
